content: Mosese ge Eloni wali Nok Houwan Kin elana

Toto o enaa, yaka Mosese ge Eloni hi na Itipita wali kin elana hi ba, “Yehoba, ama Isileli wama Yabowaine, i ba ola hiwe, ‘No gamagalau u talamwagil nihi egon, inoke hagali nihi ginol ula kekevana elana o awatauwan kaiwena.’”
Yaka kin i ba, “Henala Yehoba, ge anana na hago Isileli na talamwagil nihi egon? Yehoba nige ya aatena, inoke nige Isileli na tatalamwagil nihi eegon.”

Mosese ge Eloni hi ba, “Ama Hibilu wama Yabowaine iyaka i masal eliyama. U talamwagima lan eton naha nawanawa-an ula kekevana elana bwasumu naha powonan Yehoba wama Yabowaine elana. Ebo nigeya, tab abwe ama kasiyebwa ni teli o ebo elohaveyan kilepana elana ni lolima ge naha aliga.”
Kin i ba, “Mosese ge Eloni, ga i ola ge gamagalau wali tuwalali ku apanak. Ku sikal wami abatuwalaliya.
Komiu Isileli iyaka Itipita ku gewi lakema. Ga i ola! Tuwalali iyaka ku towani!”
Lan toto o elana, kin logugui gasigasisena i baunanik tontuwalali ge tuwalali ana tomatahikan elal i ba,
“Bahi widiwidi kekevana alona bilibili nuku pepek elal ge bilik nihi giginol! Nuku ba totoliya nihi na widiwidi nihi loya.

Yaa nuku ba al elal bilik nihi ginol ali gewi ni ola valila, bahi ali gewi ni lalau. Heliya hi pweyata, heiya te kaiwena ge hi awanun elau tage na talamwagil nihi na bwasumu nihi powonan wali Yabowaine elana!
Wali tuwalali ku pwapwabwaya-an, yaka nihi mimi tuwatuwalali ya, inoke bahi nuwaliya ni nonoek ba kakawi ana haguhagu elana.”
Inoke tontuwalali ge tuwalali ana tomatahikan hi tagil, hi na hi baek Isileli elal hi ola, “Kin i ba ola hiwe, ‘Widiwidi nige naha pepewa al.
Nuku na totomiu wami widiwidi nuku loya hauna labena elana nuku pwawaa, yaa bilik nuku ginol ali gewi ni olaolaek, bahi ni lalau.’”
Inoke Isileli, Itipita gamwana gegewena hi nemnowa-an widiwidi ana loya kaiwena.
Tontuwalali Isileli hi palawakikil hi ba, “Lan maisena maisena bilik nuku ginolil ali gewi ni ola sauga toto widiwidi hi pewa eliyamiu.”

Yaka tontuwalali tuwalali ana tomatahikan hi nibihil hi ba, “Ga i ola ge bilik nige ku giginolil ali gewi i oola valila?” Tontuwalali heliya gagama Itipita. Tuwalali ana tomatahikan heliya Isileli bolo Itipita hi hilel tuwalali nihi matahikan.
Inoke tuwalali ana tomatahikan hi na kin elana hi ba, “Ga i ola ge u giginol ola eliyama?
Widiwidi nige hi pepem eliyama, yaa hi ba bilik naha ginolil! Yaka hi nibinibihagima! Wam gamagalau hi gegi te hi ginol ola eliyama.”
Yaka kin i ba, “Komiu topweyata, ku pweyata hot! Heiya te kaiwena ku mimi baaba tage na talamwagimiu nuku na bwasumu nuku powonan Yehoba elana.
Ku sikal, ku na ku tuwalali! Widiwidi nige nihi pepewa, yaa bilik nuku ginolil ali gewi ni olaolaek toto valila.”
Tuwalali ana tomatahikan hi atena te i pulowan elal, kaiwena kin i ba. “Lan maisena maisena bilik nuku ginolil ali gewi ni ola toto valila.”
Yehoba I Bateli Isileli Ni Pwamwalil
Sauga kin hi eguluwan, inoke hi na Mosese ge Eloni hi pwawal heliya hi matamatan kaiweliya.
Yaka hi baek Mosese ge Eloni elal hi ba, “Ha awanun Yehoba ni lahemiu, kaiwena kin alonau ge ana tolabe tineliya ku palut ge hi pihigelgel-agima. He wami ginol kaiwena bosowailiya te nihi lolima.”
Inoke Mosese i na i awanun Yehoba elana i ba, “Babala, ga i ola ge pulowan u pwatanim wam gamagalau elal? Age toto o kaiwena heiya u patunau ge ya nem?
Ya nok kin elana wam baaba ya baunanik, inoke nak i ginol gamagalau elal. Nige bugul etega u giginol ge nu pwamwalil!”
